datasets.interpretation: Named entities in historical Romanian. The adapter preserves the original JSON arrays and maps every class ID according to the published class-label notice. It retains all original source rows and fields, including the original empty token strings and their class IDs. Use --ner-scoring source for the literal PERS versus PER audit. Dataset scoring aligns PERS with PER and PROD with PRODUCT. Among 66 original empty token strings, 15 have a non-O tag. Two single-token B-PROD spans in validation have start equal to end. Source scoring includes both in authored gold. Dataset scoring reports both explicitly as unscorable and removes only separator padding from nonempty mention boundaries.

BBQ.reason: JSONL NER file for BBQ contains no valid sentences

CopticUD.reason: Annotations are CC BY 4.0. The mixed splits include transcriptions and translations for which the embedded texts’ redistribution terms were not established.

ENer.reason: The source contains 415,369 labeled rows including four tags outside BIO. The native reader reports 415,317 tokens; the discrepancy has not been reconciled.

FewRel.reason: The direct pack includes the source predicate mapping and relation groups. A full paired native relation evaluation was outside this cache selection.

GICoref.reason: The generic native CoNLL view produced 62,332 tokens versus 62,138 source tokens in the released document file. The raw pack retains all 91 documents.

GUM.reason: The publisher archive carries source-licensed original files and credits. The generic native CoNLL view does not establish the full GUM entity layers or coreference chains.

KoCoNovel.reason: GAP TSV file for KoCoNovel contains no valid sentences

MathDial.reason: JSONL NER file for MathDial contains no valid sentences

MedievalCharterNER.reason: On the original combined training file the generic native CoNLL view produced 1,828,785 tokens versus 1,827,779 source tokens. A dedicated reader is needed.

MuDoCo.reason: CrossRE-style JSON for MuDoCo contains no valid sentences

MultiWOZNER.reason: JSONL NER file for MultiWOZNER contains no valid sentences

NoiseBench.reason: The English release supplies annotation sequences over [TOK] placeholders. A native text-extraction score would lack the source words. See the publisher pack for the authorized masked file.

RAMS.reason: The direct source pack can measure all 7,329 training event windows. The native parser returned no usable sentences on the original training input.

StereoSet.reason: Registry identifies the public dataset but provides no native parser

WikiGold.reason: The source authors release the annotations as CC BY 4.0 in Figshare 5462500 v1. The 146 source-document markers are anonymous, without Wikipedia article links needed to carry the underlying text attribution. Local download remains available for appropriately authorized evaluation.

WinoBias.reason: GAP TSV file for WinoBias contains no valid sentences

WinoQueer.reason: Registry identifies the public dataset but provides no native parser

Wnut17.reason: The WNUT-17 release declares CC BY 4.0, but the anonymous token files contain third-party social text without the original post and author references needed for the works in these files.

omitted_inputs.reason: Missing BIO label on line 44,520. The direct native loader could otherwise silently shorten the file. The publisher package has the untouched original.
